description: Server-side utilities for react-awesome-query-builder (RAQB) that facilitate safe import and usage without client-only dependencies. Includes functions for query validation, attribute data processing, and configuration generation.

methods.name: ensureArray
methods.description: Converts a string or array of strings into an array of strings.

methods.name: isQueryValueARuleGroup
methods.description: Checks if a JsonTree object is a rule group.

methods.name: isARule
methods.description: Checks if a JsonItem object is a rule.

methods.name: getValueTypeFromAttributesQueryValueForRaqbField
methods.description: Retrieves the value type of a specific RAQB field from a query value.

methods.name: isQueryValueEmpty
methods.description: Determines if a query value is empty.

methods.name: getValueOfAttributeOption
methods.description: Extracts values from attribute options, handling groups and flattening.

methods.name: getAttributesData
methods.description: Maps attribute data to form-compatible values, considering attribute types.

methods.name: getAttributesQueryValue
methods.description: Resolves the query value for attributes used in route generation.

methods.name: getAttributesQueryBuilderConfigHavingListofLabels
methods.description: Generates RAQB config with label-based list values for attributes.
